An extinct '''bird species''' once inhabited the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]], feeding on the native [[gankto tree]]. To thwart the [[Bird/Legends|birds]], who nested in its upper regions, the [[Tree/Legends|tree]] began growing [[Plant/Legends|leaves]] only on its bottom branches, which led to the birds being caught and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by predators.
